fields.title: MIAMI LIFE, Saturday, February 12, 1927
creator: WEN R. PHILLIPS, Editor and Publisher
fields.format: Digitized newspaper pages with OCR text
subject: Taxation—Florida
Local taxation—Miami (Fla.)
Public transportation—Bus lines—Miami (Fla.)

fields.description: Issue includes editor’s mail and letters on taxation and civic conditions; a continuing investigative series criticizing the City of Miami’s bus agreement with the Miami Beach Railway company (fare, transfers, profit/deficit terms, and long contract duration); reporting and commentary on oil-lease speculation and drilling west of Miami on the Tamiami Trail; local civic satire and miscellany; sports coverage including boxing, tennis (Molla Mallory vs. Bob Gifford), and golf tournament notes; and society/entertainment columns and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach businesses and venues.
contributor: Mr. Lee, the state prohibition director
